failure_modes: Adopting a temporal_teacher_blend dose (C007/C008/C009) on weak, sign-conflicting curve evidence could displace surrounding coordinates without an affinity benefit, since the audited curves show fit infidelity and last-node sign disagreement rather than a reliable time-conditioned direction.

Misreading the temporal contrast as a trajectory velocity force or as a spatial gradient would apply an unvalidated force and unnecessarily displace surrounding coordinates; the registered temporal_teacher recipe is a coordinate reward with no velocity target.

Treating the positive compressed-choice excess RMS as evidence of final affinity benefit would be unsupported: terminal affinity labels are unavailable and the chosen-teacher score correlation is weak, so last-record credit cannot be presented as affinity gain.
Any proposal to alter mixture_temperature or teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 would be an interface violation, not a research condition; temperatures are immutable and no such edit is made.
rationale: Analyst's temporal evidence is coordinate-reward evidence only: the audited contrast curves are coordinate rewards, not trajectory velocity forces, and no temporal derivative is a spatial gradient. The offered time-conditioned alternatives (C007/C008/C009 temporal_teacher_blend) change only the dose/blend of the registered temporal_teacher recipe, which reuses the same static teachers and the same shared FLOWR endpoint with no velocity target; they do not change teacher coordinates or regional attention. The only registered edits that would change regional attention are the temporal_region recipe, which is not offered as a bounded choice here. The evidence for a time-conditioned advantage is weak and unresolved: curve fidelity is poor (relative node RMSE ~0.39-0.93, all above the 0.35 rule) with widespread strong sign conflicts, and last-empirical-z versus last-fit-z signs frequently disagree, so the fitted contrast direction is not reliably reproduced at the last observed node (H001's falsifier is not clearly avoided). The selection advantage is a small geometric excess that does not translate into a strong affinity-credit signal, and terminal affinity labels are unavailable (H002). Under the affinity-first objective, no offered edit provides a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent static coordinate program, so retaining the incumbent is the correct bounded choice. No temperature edit is proposed; temperatures are immutable task parameters.
